prompts.name: settings
prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: LingNote Windows desktop settings navigation icon, raster PNG with actual transparent background. Primary request: a single precise minimalist outline gear/cog settings icon, centered, eight rounded teeth, round empty center. Modern Windows UI line icon. Charcoal #525252 strokes, uniform rounded stroke 2 units on a conceptual 24x24 grid, no filled silhouette. Icon occupies 76% of square canvas; generous equal transparent margins. Perfectly clean sharp antialiased contours, readable at 18 px. No text, no label, no shadow, no gradient, no tile, no background, no perspective, no extra symbols. All non-stroke pixels must be truly transparent.
